{{ModifierInfobox |title1 = Fog |image1 = FogModifier.png |affects = Tower Stats
Map Appearance |active_in = [[Challenge Trials]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = +20% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All tower ranges reduced by 35%|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Fog''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Quarantine]] and before [[Limitation Makes Creativity]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match. ==Effects== When applied, the range of towers will be reduced by 35%. A fog will also appear on the map. Towers also have their range rounded the closest integer, calculated as: \text{Base Range} \times 0.65 Due to this rounding, the actual range decrease will actually vary significantly, making it either higher (for example, Level 0 [[Slime Trooper]] range becomes 7.475, rounded down to 7, a 39.1% debuff) or lower (for example, Level 0 [[Snowballer]] will have its range reduced to 9.75, rounded up to 10, a 33.33% debuff). For the case of other things which affect range, primarily the [[Range Buff]] and [[Skills]], these will happen before the '''Fog''' range reduction and rounding. For instance, with fully upgraded Enhanced Optics, the range of a Level 0 [[Slime Trooper]] will first get increased by 10% to 12.65, then it will get reduced by 65% to 8.2225 which is rounded down to 8. ==Update History== *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Fog''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Reward boost lowered from +30% to +20%. {{ModifierNavBox}}
